mapper.select: SELECT module_srl, mid, browser_title FROM xe_modules WHERE mid IN ('newjob', 'additional') ORDER BY FIELD(mid, 'newjob', 'additional')

SELECT d.document_srl, d.module_srl, m.mid, d.title, d.content, d.status, d.regdate, d.last_update FROM xe_documents d INNER JOIN xe_modules m ON m.module_srl = d.module_srl WHERE m.mid IN ('newjob', 'additional') ORDER BY d.document_srl DESC

SELECT d.document_srl, d.module_srl, m.mid, d.title, d.content, d.status, d.regdate, d.last_update FROM xe_documents d INNER JOIN xe_modules m ON m.module_srl = d.module_srl WHERE d.document_srl = #{documentSrl} AND m.mid IN ('newjob', 'additional')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO xe_documents ( document_srl, module_srl, category_srl, lang_code, is_notice, title, title_bold, content, readed_count, voted_count, blamed_count, comment_count, trackback_count, uploaded_count, user_id, user_name, nick_name, member_srl, email_address, homepage, extra_vars, regdate, last_update, last_updater, ipaddress, list_order, update_order, allow_trackback, notify_message, status, comment_status ) VALUES ( #{documentSrl}, #{moduleSrl}, 0, 'ko', 'N', #{title}, 'N', #{content}, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, '', 'Researchi Admin', 'Researchi Admin', 0, '', '', '', #{regdate}, #{lastUpdate}, 'Researchi Admin', #{ipAddress}, #{listOrder}, #{documentSrl}, 'Y', 'N', #{status}, 'ALLOW' )
mapper.update: UPDATE xe_documents SET module_srl = #{moduleSrl}, title = #{title}, content = #{content}, status = #{status}, last_update = #{lastUpdate} WHERE document_srl = #{documentSrl}
